claims.claim: Amphilochius of Iconium was a fourth‑century bishop (archbishop) of the see of Iconium in Lycaonia.
He was born around 339/340, probably in Caesarea of Cappadocia, and died between 394 and 403.
The Epistula synodalis is a synodal letter written by Amphilochius after the Council of Iconium in 376.
Its purpose was to defend the divinity of the Holy Spirit against the Macedonian (semi‑Pneumatomachian) heresy that denied the Spirit’s full deity.
A later edition appeared in C. Datema’s Corpus Christianorum Series Graeca (1978), but it did not incorporate all known manuscripts, prompting the preparation of a new critical edition.
